problems: Pinsk and Turov are written as two states, not one: they share Q671362 with principality-of-turov-and-pinsk (eu-16-e, ends 1293), but the Turov page has Pinsk as a separate appanage already under a Gediminid; the shapes do not overlap.

principality-of-pinsk ends 1320 on the Pinsk page ('By 1320, Pinsk was incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania'); grand-duchy-of-lithuania (eu-15) and Cliopatria give 1326, leaving 1321-1325 unclaimed unless one is moved.

Cliopatria's Nizhny Novgorod disc is centred about 90 km west-north-west of the city and no Cliopatria shape covers the city at any date; nizhny-novgorod moves the disc and the Moscow keyframes from 1392 add a 42 km disc at the city and from 1389 a 70 km disc at Vladimir.

grand-principality-of-moscow starts 1263 (page infobox) and ends 1546 (the Tsardom of Russia dossier begins January 1547); it adds 14 new keyframes (dates Cliopatria shows late or early against the pages) and a Novgorod protectorate 1471-1478 that removes Novgorod's north from the 1475-1477 shape.

Moscow's events for Pereslavl (1302), Mozhaysk (1304), Beloozero, Rostov and Yaroslavl carry years that differ from the matching Cliopatria-year events in the vladimir-suzdal, smolensk and beloozero dossiers; each cites its own page.

15 distinct pages opened (sources_total counts a page once per dossier citing it); Pinsk used three pages against a budget of 1-2 (one silent on dates); one URL failed (Suzdal_Principality) and Principality_of_Suzdal loaded as the Vladimir-Suzdal article.
